decisions.mark: names MBEDTLS_THREADING_C and MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD as the gating macros
decisions.detail: QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is declared with default `off` at `include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787`, and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` is default `off` at `:2196`. | WHY: The answer names both MBEDTLS_THREADING_C and MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD as the macros controlling threading, and says concurrency exists only if the integrator enables them.

decisions.mark: states that the shipped mbedtls_config.h leaves BOTH threading macros undefined, so a default build defines neither
decisions.detail: QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is declared with default `off` at `include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787`, and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` is default `off` at `:2196`. | WHY: The answer says both threading macros (THREADING_C and THREADING_PTHREAD) are off by default in the shipped mbedtls_config.h, so a default build defines neither.

decisions.mark: concludes that a default build of mbedtls creates no threads at all, and that the pthread example compiles to a stub main under that condition
decisions.detail: QUOTE: NONE | WHY: The answer says the library spawns no threads of its own and that only the example programs do. It does not conclude that a default build creates no threads at all, and it does not say the pthread example compiles to a stub main under default config. It even says the index was built with threading on.

decisions.mark: states BOTH halves of the contrast: that nothing in library/ creates a thread, AND that library/ nonetheless supplies the mutex abstraction used by threaded callers
decisions.detail: QUOTE: "Library-internal threads | None. The index finds no spawn site in `library/`." and "Lock wrapper: `mbedtls_threading_mutex_t` with `mbedtls_mutex_init/lock/unlock/free` in `include/mbedtls/threading.h`, backed by pthread functions in `library/threading.c`." | WHY: The answer states that library/ has no thread spawn sites and that library/threading.c supplies the mutex abstraction (wrapper and global mutexes) used by threaded callers.
